cohort: 5447 pregnant women who delivered at >=23 weeks of gestation at a hospital in Barcelona, Spain
finding: Pre-pregnancy overweight or obesity was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, induction of labor, caesarean section, prematurity, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was more frequent in women with pre-pregnancy overweight (OR 1.41) and obesity (OR 2.68).
